groups.defect: When credential sync is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a native fetch Response, but migrated callers expect provider- or Axios-shaped results. Google reads res.data, and the HubSpot, Zoho Bigin and Zoho CRM callers read tokenInfo.data. Those fields are undefined, so the token refresh breaks.

answer.reasoning: All four suggestions report the same root defect. In refreshOAuthTokens, the sync branch returns a raw fetch Response, but callers expect a different shape. s_758c1e0e reports it from the Google call site, and the other three report it from the helper while naming different affected callers: s_a6b7494b names HubSpot and Zoho, s_a724fc12 names Bigin, and s_f18b98f6 names Google, HubSpot and Bigin. Normalizing what the helper returns, or parsing the response in each caller, fixes all of them, so the grouping is clear: one cross_location group. Both judges agree on the grouping. They disagree only on needsUnifiedComment. I set it to true because the members name different affected callers. Callers expect different shapes (Google and Axios callers want .data, while HubSpot uses the token object directly), so the merged comment has to list every affected caller, and a fix may need edits at several call sites. That flag is a judgment call, so decisive is false.
